Method of Attack: Exploitation of CVE-2017-7269 vulnerability in IIS 6.0 WebDAV service to take over vulnerable machines and install a Monero miner
Use of publicly available proof-of-concept exploit code modified to download and execute malicious payload
Deployment of a custom Monero miner with hardcoded attacker wallet address and mining pool URL
Scanning for exposed IIS 6.0 servers using publicly available scanning tools
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unpatched IIS 6.0 WebDAV service vulnerability (CVE-2017-7269)
Indicators of Compromise: Modified Monero miner based on xmrig 0.8.2 with hardcoded command line arguments for attacker wallet and mining pool URL
Use of shellcode converted to alphanumeric string to execute malicious payload
Microsoft patch KB3197835 addresses the exploited vulnerability
